Overview

HYSYS - Demethanizer

Overview

Unit purpose

This running model separates a methane-rich gas feed into Sales Gas and an ethane-rich NGL stream sent To Fractionator. Feed pre-cooling, chilling, phase separation, turboexpansion, heat recovery, a reboiled demethanizer and overhead recycle work together to recover heavier hydrocarbons while returning methane-rich residue gas to compression.

HYSYS kgmole/h is equivalent to kmol/h. Controller PV and SP units are shown as HYSYS native where the API did not export the unit; do not compare these directly to hourly stream flows.

Control structure

FIC-100 sets feed throughput. ERIC-100 sends a recovery-related demand to the TIC-100 separator-temperature cascade. LIC-100 controls separator liquid withdrawal. RIC-100 adjusts the expander / booster energy coupling. PIC-100 acts through residue-gas recompression. LIC-101 regulates bottoms withdrawal. XIC-100 acts on column duty, and RFIC-100 acts on overhead recycle compression. Detailed bindings and observed tuning appear on the Control loops page.

Process flow

HYSYS - Demethanizer

Process flow

Feed cooling and separation

Feed -> VLV-100 -> 2 -> E-101 -> 4 -> Chiller -> 7 -> Separator. The Separator splits the conditioned feed into liquid 8 and vapor 9. E-101 also receives cold residue stream 3 and exports warmed residue 5.

Cold feed branches

Vapor 9 enters TEE-101: branch 10 goes through Turboexpander to column feed 17; branch 11 goes through VLV-107 to 12. Separator liquid 8 passes VLV-101 to 13 and TEE-100. Branch 15 passes VLV-102 to column feed 16. Branch 14 passes VLV-103 to 19. MIX-100 combines 19 and bypass 12 into 18.

Heat recovery and recycle-fed column inlets

E-102 exchanges between streams 18 and 27, with outlets 20 and 3. Stream 20 passes VLV-104 to 21. E-103 exchanges between 21 and recycle 23, producing column feed 22 and stream 24. Stream 24 passes VLV-105 -> 25 -> RCY-1 -> column feed 26.

Column and products

Demethanizer receives 16, 17, 22 and 26. The internal Main Tower and Reboiler provide the separation and boilup. Bottoms NGL pass VLV-106 to To Fractionator. Overhead 28 enters TEE-102: branch 27 returns through E-102 and E-101, then 5 -> Booster -> 6 -> Recompressor -> Sales Gas. Branch 29 goes through Cryogenic Compressor to 23 and returns through E-103 and RCY-1 to the column.

Scope and repeated labels

The column internal flowsheet repeats some main-flowsheet stream labels. Cards marked column internal are separate scoped objects. Internal overhead 23 and main-flowsheet overhead 28 are recorded at different hierarchy levels; the main-flowsheet recycle stream 23 is the Cryogenic Compressor outlet. Follow scope and connections rather than the numeric label alone.
